en.name: Cereal, cook before eating
en.summary: Cereals you cook before eating — rolled oats, oatmeal, semolina porridge and the like — keep about 12 months from purchase unopened and 6–12 months once the box is opened, in an airtight container in a cool, dry cupboard.
en.pantry: An unopened box keeps about 12 months from purchase; once opened, decant it into an airtight container and use it within 6–12 months. Commercial rolled oats have been steamed during processing, which knocks out the enzyme that would otherwise turn the fat quickly — that is why a box of oats keeps far longer than the whole oat groats it was made from. The two everyday threats are damp, which clumps the flakes and eventually moulds them, and pantry moths, which are drawn to oats more than to almost anything else on the shelf.
en.fridge: No refrigerator timeline is published for hot cereals, so none is given here, and a dry cupboard is the better home for a dry flake in most kitchens. In a very hot, humid climate an airtight jar in the fridge slows the fat turning and keeps moths out — bring it back to room temperature before opening so condensation forms on the container rather than on the cereal. Cooked porridge is a different food and should be cooled quickly and refrigerated covered.
en.freezer: No freezer figure is given for these cereals. Freezing a sealed bag for a few days is a genuinely effective way to kill pantry moth eggs in a bulk purchase, and longer freezing slows the fat oxidising, but neither is a documented shelf life and this page will not turn a habit into a number. Buy the size of box you will finish within the opened window instead.
spoilage: A bitter, soapy or paint-like smell — the fat in the flakes has turned.
Webbing, larvae, small moths or fine dust in the container, which oats attract readily.
Clumping or damp patches, meaning moisture has got in.
Porridge that tastes bitter however it is sweetened or salted.
tips: Decant the box into an airtight container the day you open it.
Check for webbing before cooking from a container that has sat a while.
Freeze a bulk bag for a few days to settle the moth question.
Keep the container away from the hob and the kettle.

faq.q: How long do rolled oats keep?
faq.a: About 12 months from purchase unopened, and 6–12 months once opened and kept in an airtight container.

faq.q: Why do rolled oats keep longer than whole oat groats?
faq.a: Rolled oats are steamed during processing, which deactivates the enzyme that would otherwise turn the fat quickly.

faq.q: Should cereal be kept in the fridge?
faq.a: Not normally — a dry cupboard is better. In a very humid kitchen an airtight jar in the fridge is reasonable.

zh.name: 需烹煮的穀片
zh.summary: 需要煮過才吃的穀片——壓片燕麥、燕麥粥料、小麥粥粉之類——未開封從購買日起算約可放 12 個月；開封後裝進密封容器、放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，6～12 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封的盒裝從購買日起算約 12 個月；一開封就倒進密封容器，並在 6～12 個月內用完。市售壓片燕麥在加工時經過蒸汽處理，破壞了會讓油脂快速變質的酵素——這就是一盒燕麥片比它原料的全粒燕麥耐放很多的原因。日常兩大威脅是受潮（讓麥片結塊、最後發霉）和穀蛾，而燕麥對穀蛾的吸引力幾乎勝過架上任何東西。
zh.fridge: 這類熱穀片沒有公布的冷藏期限，所以本頁不給；對乾燥的麥片來說，大多數廚房裡乾燥櫥櫃才是更好的位置。在非常濕熱的氣候，密封罐放冰箱能延緩油脂變質、也擋得住蛾——開封前先回到室溫，讓水氣凝在容器上而不是麥片上。煮好的粥則是另一種食物，要快速降溫並加蓋冷藏。
zh.freezer: 這類穀片沒有給冷凍數字。把密封袋冷凍幾天，確實是殺死大量採購時穀蛾卵的有效方法，長期冷凍也能延緩油脂氧化，但兩者都不是有出處的保存期限，本頁不會把習慣寫成數字。與其如此，不如買開封後期限內吃得完的盒數。
spoilage: 聞到苦味、肥皂味或油漆味——麥片裡的油脂變質了。
容器內出現絲網、幼蟲、小蛾或細粉屑；燕麥特別容易招來牠們。
結塊或出現受潮區塊，代表水氣跑進去了。
煮成的粥不管加糖加鹽都帶苦味。
tips: 開封當天就把整盒倒進密封容器。
放了一陣子的容器，煮之前先檢查有沒有絲網。
大包裝先冷凍幾天，把穀蛾的問題解決掉。
容器遠離爐台和熱水瓶。

faq.a: 未開封從購買日起算約 12 個月；開封後裝密封容器 6～12 個月。

faq.q: 為什麼壓片燕麥比全粒燕麥耐放？
faq.a: 壓片燕麥在加工時經過蒸汽處理，讓那個會加速油脂變質的酵素失去活性。
一般不用——乾燥櫥櫃比較好。非常潮濕的廚房裡，密封罐放冰箱是合理的。
